title: Usage
description: What your tools cost and how often they ran, counted on this computer.

empty.allBody: Every call from the playground and your agents is counted here, with its estimated cost.

chart.noSpend: No spend recorded in this range.
chart.noCallsProvider: No calls in this range for this provider.

provider.label: Provider
provider.title: By provider
provider.empty: No provider calls in this range. Calls that use no provider count under tools only.

tool.title: By tool
tool.more: Showing the {shown} most used of {total} tools.

footnote: Spend is an estimate from each provider's list prices; your provider's bill is the real figure. Days start at midnight UTC.

caps.title: Spend caps
caps.none: No caps. Add one to limit what tools may spend.
caps.noneSet: No caps set: tools spend without a limit. Add a daily or monthly cap that blocks or asks you first.
caps.help: Provider ids are the names in the "By provider" list (for example fal or replicate). Days and months start in UTC.
caps.brokenBody: Until it is fixed or removed, calls that may cost money are refused. It is never overwritten from here, so fix the file by hand.
caps.footBefore: A cap that asks sends requests to
caps.footAfter: . A cap that blocks refuses the call; another provider may still run it.
